label: Field Notebook
description: Dated journal blog for travel notes, field reports, and personal logs. Margin metadata and paper texture — not a magazine cover or a docs site.
signatureMotif: dated entries, margin metadata, and paper-like reading columns
promptHints: Treat the index as a chronological notebook: date first, short title, one-line place or weather note. No hero magazine cover.
Article pages read as a field report: wide left margin for date/location, a single reading column, and a small sketch or photo inset — not a 3-column news grid.
Paper, ink, and muted earth. Avoid tech-docs chrome and luxury fashion magazines.

layouts: Home is a vertical log: each entry is date (small-caps) + title + 2-line excerpt + a place tag, separated by a hairline. No card tiles and no featured-hero image taking half the viewport.
Post layout is a single measure (max-w-prose) with a persistent left rail showing date, location, and reading time. Pull-quotes sit in the margin, not in colored callout boxes.
A trip or series page groups entries as a timeline of dates, not as a masonry image gallery.
Footer stays quiet: previous/next entry by date, not related-posts cards.
motifs: Warm paper background (#F6F1E8 or similar), brown-black ink, and one terracotta or moss mark for tags.
Source Serif / Merriweather for titles; body 18–20px with 1.7 line-height. Dates in small-caps tabular figures.
Photography is a single inset print with a thin rule — like a photo taped into a notebook — not a full-bleed fashion crop.
antiPatterns: Do not use editorial-serif magazine covers, oversized display type, or a featured-story hero with a full-bleed portrait.
Avoid tech-minimal docs chrome: left nav of API sections, mono code-first index, or dark developer theme.
No 3-up post cards with hover lift, category chips, or newsletter popups as the first screen.
